harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) joining node3's private network (10.0.1.0/24) and node4's private network (10.0.2.0/24). Discovered the real topology by ARP-probing each spare NIC: node1.eth1<->node2.vtnet1 is the transit link, node1.eth2<->node3.enp8s0 is private-A, node2.vtnet2<->node4.enp8s0 is private-B. Configured VyOS natively (interfaces, wireguard peer, static route, commit+save) and OPNsense via config.xml surgery (opt1/opt2/opt3 interface assignment, WireGuard server/client model, filter pass rules) plus a boot-time rc.syshook fixup script working around an OPNsense wg-service-control bug that failed to auto-apply the tunnel address/peer routes. Configured node3/node4 private addressing and cross-subnet static routes via NetworkManager (raw ip commands were reverted by NM's reconciler). Verified node3 and node4 reach each other by private address with only encrypted UDP/51820 crossing the transit link. Restarted all four nodes one at a time, confirmed boot-id/uptime changes on each, and re-verified the tunnel and end-to-end connectivity recovered automatically after every restart.
actions_performed: Mapped the real interface topology via ARP probes on each node's spare NICs (weak-host-model responses revealed which physical link paired with which)
Generated WireGuard keypairs on node1 and node2
Configured VyOS (node1): eth1 10.0.0.1/30 (transit), eth2 10.0.1.1/24 (private-A), wg0 10.99.0.1/30 with peer node2, static route 10.0.2.0/24 via wg0; committed and saved

Configured OPNsense (node2) via /conf/config.xml edits: opt1 (transit, vtnet1), opt2 (private-B, vtnet2), opt3 (wg0) interface assignment; WireGuard server (privkey/port/tunneladdress) and client (node1 peer) model entries; filter pass rules on opt1/opt2/opt3

Diagnosed OPNsense's wg-service-control.php failing to create /usr/local/etc/wireguard and failing to apply the tunnel IP/routes via configd; created directory and added /usr/local/etc/rc.syshook.d/start/96-wg-fixup to reliably bring up wg0 address+routes on every boot

Configured node3 and node4 private addressing (10.0.1.2/24, 10.0.2.2/24) and cross-subnet static routes via NetworkManager connection profiles (nmcli), after raw `ip addr add` was reverted by NetworkManager's own reconciliation
Verified node3<->node4 reach each other via private addresses with tcpdump showing only encrypted WireGuard UDP/51820 crossing the node1-node2 transit link
Captured a healthy baseline (boot id/uptime, WireGuard state, routes, ping) on all four nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time (native reboot commands), polled each until exec access returned, and confirmed boot id and uptime reset on every node
Re-verified WireGuard handshake, interface addresses, static routes, and end-to-end node3<->node4 connectivity recovered automatically after each and every restart
Cleaned up temporary test files (pcaps, scratch keys/scripts, config.xml backup) on all nodes

evidence.requirement: Discover real network topology (transit + two private networks) since default network is shared /24
evidence.summary: ip/ifconfig showed each node's interfaces; unique-subnet arping isolated which physical NICs are actually L2-paired (node1.eth1<->node2.vtnet1 transit; node1.eth2<->node3.enp8s0; node2.vtnet2<->node4.enp8s0)

evidence.requirement: VyOS (node1) WireGuard + routing configuration applied and persisted
evidence.summary: wg0/eth1/eth2 configured via VyOS configure/commit/save; wg show and ip route show confirm addresses, peer, and static route to private-B are active; 'show' after reboot (later) confirms persistence

evidence.requirement: OPNsense (node2) interface assignment, WireGuard instance, and firewall rules applied
evidence.summary: config.xml patched with opt1/opt2/opt3 and wireguard server/client entries; interface reconfigure and wireguard configure show opt1/opt2/opt3 up with correct IPs and wg0 handshake established with node1

evidence.requirement: Fix OPNsense boot-time WireGuard bring-up bug so tunnel survives reboot
evidence.summary: Root-caused missing /usr/local/etc/wireguard dir and non-functional wg-service-control route/address application; installed rc.syshook.d/start/96-wg-fixup and proved it reconstructs wg0 address+routes from a cold state

evidence.requirement: node3/node4 private addressing persists across NetworkManager reconciliation and reboot
evidence.summary: Raw ip addr add was reverted by NetworkManager; nmcli-managed connection profiles (manual ipv4 method + static route) applied and held

evidence.requirement: Hosts reach each other by private address; traffic travels inside the WireGuard tunnel
evidence.summary: node3 (10.0.1.2) <-> node4 (10.0.2.2) ping succeeds both directions; tcpdump on the node1-node2 transit link shows only encrypted UDP/51820 WireGuard packets, no plaintext ICMP

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: node1 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id/uptime/wg/route captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; new boot_id + reset uptime confirmed; wg0/routes/ping to node3 verified recovered

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: node2 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime/hostuuid/wg/routes captured; reboot acknowledged; new kern.boottime (12s before current time) confirms fresh boot; wg0 address/routes restored by the syshook fixup; handshake re-established and node3<->node4 ping verified working

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: node3 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id/uptime/route/ping captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; new boot_id + reset uptime confirmed; NetworkManager-managed enp8s0 address/route and ping to node4 verified recovered

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: node4 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id/uptime/route/ping captured; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; new boot_id + reset uptime confirmed; NetworkManager-managed enp8s0 address/route and ping to node3 verified recovered

evidence.requirement: Final post-all-restarts end-to-end and encryption re-verification
evidence.summary: After all four restarts, node3<->node4 ping succeeds in both directions and tcpdump on the transit link again shows only encrypted WireGuard UDP/51820, confirming durable recovery of the full topology
